name: Abijah
overview: Abijah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Becher. His mention is brief and specific, focusing on his genealogical placement within the Benjaminite lineage as recorded in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Abijah means '[my] father is y-h-v-h,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges the Lord as a father figure. This proper name is noted in 1 Chronicles 7:8 and was not given directly by God but carries significant spiritual meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Abijah is explicitly recorded as the son of Becher, establishing his direct paternal relationship within the tribe of Benjamin. Scripture does not provide further family details beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Abijah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical role within the tribe of Benjamin, serving as a link in the biblical record of Israel's tribal families. His mention in 1 Chronicles 7:8 helps preserve the lineage and heritage important for understanding the people of Israel as ordained by God.
